Forces: red weight, cyan buoyancy, yellow drag, magenta contact, orange thrust, lavender added mass and wave inertia, dark teal wave radiation, blue lift (hull trailing edge, rudder), green net (1 m = 1000 N; capped at 3 m). Flow: white air, blue water (1 m = 4 m/s; capped at 1 m); light-blue dots mark the sampled wave surface. Ambient samples, not CFD wakes; only visible to you.
